Goldman Sachs' provided candidates discuss strategic divestitures and sales of consumer businesses (Marcus, PFM, GreenSky) rather than organizational restructuring or segment reclassification of existing businesses. Additionally, one candidate is generic definitions of terms, and another lists divestiture transactions, none of which involve the type of internal segment reclassification or transfer of winding-down businesses from one segment to another seen at Citi.

comparisons.peer_summary: Effective in Q2 2024, JPMorgan reorganized its reportable segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking into the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), resulting in three total reportable segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and JPMorgan Chase executed major organizational restructuring and segment reclassifications effective in the second quarter of 2024 to align with management structures. Citi transferred its winding-down U.K. retail banking business from the Wealth segment to Legacy Franchises within All Other to simplify its organization. Similarly, JPMorgan combined its former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking segments into a single reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), to reflect new management structures. Both actions involved significant reclassification of prior periods' financial statements to conform to the new presentation.

sentences.text: During the second quarter of 2024, Citi made certain reclassifications to align with its organizational simplification and strategy.
In connection therewith, Citi transferred the retail banking business in the U.K., which is being wound down, from Wealth to Legacy Franchises (managed basis) within All Other (managed basis).

Effective in the second quarter of 2024, the Firm reorganized its reportable business segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking business segments to form one reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank ("CIB").

As a result of the reorganization, the Firm has three reportable business segments - Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management - with the remaining activities in Corporate.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2023, the Retail Municipal and Corporate Fixed Income business was combined with the Parametric retail customized solutions business, resulting in a $6 billion movement in AUM from Fixed Income to the Alternatives and Solutions asset class included in Other.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and Morgan Stanley reported reclassifications and changes to their business segment compositions that impacted prior period comparability. Citi reclassified prior periods to align with organizational simplification, transferring the U.K. retail banking business from Wealth to Legacy Franchises. Morgan Stanley reported a $6 billion movement in Assets Under Management (AUM) from Fixed Income to Alternatives and Solutions (Other) resulting from combining the Retail Municipal and Corporate Fixed Income business with the Parametric retail customized solutions business. While the specific vehicles differed (banking business transfer vs. AUM classification change), both entities adjusted their segment reporting structures and reclassified prior periods to conform to the current presentation.
